description: This file defines an interface 'IControllable' within the 'Orleans.Providers' namespace, representing controllable components in the Orleans runtime that can execute control commands asynchronously.

classes.name: IControllable
classes.description: Interface for controllable components that can execute control commands asynchronously.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a control command with a specified command identifier and argument, returning the result as a Task<object>.
